# VI Countdown: GTA 6 release countdown, news and facts

> Fan site (not affiliated with Rockstar Games) tracking Grand Theft Auto VI: live countdown to the November 19, 2026 release, official facts, press news in 12 languages updated twice a day, editions and prices, Vice Bay Radio player and the Vice Break mobile game. Available in French, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Russian and Korean (add ?lang=xx to any page).

## Key facts (verified against Rockstar Games)
- Release date: November 19, 2026, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Confirmed November 6, 2025 after two delays.
- PC: not at launch.
- Price: Standard Edition $79.99, Ultimate Edition $99.99. Pre-orders opened June 25, 2026 (bonus: Vintage Vice City Pack).
- Setting: the fictional state of Leonida (inspired by Florida) and Vice City (inspired by Miami).
- Protagonists: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, the series' first playable duo.
- Videos: Trailer 1 (Dec 2023), Trailer 2 (May 2025), "An Extended Look" 26 min gameplay (Aug 27, 2026).
- Languages: 13 at launch; Arabic is not included. Arab players campaign with #GTA6Arabic.
